mapper.insert: insert into project (name, priority, type ,status,pm,pm_id,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, `desc`, create_man_id, create_man) values (#{name}, #{priority}, #{type},#{status}, #{pmName},#{pmId},#{planStartDate},#{planEndDate}, #{desc}, #{createManId}, #{createMan})
mapper.select: select id,name, priority, type ,status,pm_id,pm pmName ,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, actual_start_date,actual_end_date,`desc`, create_man_id, create_man,create_date,modify_date from project where id = #{id} and is_deleted=false

select a.id,a.name, a.priority, a.type ,a.status,a.pm_id,a.pm pmName ,a.plan_start_date,a.plan_end_date, a.actual_start_date,a.actual_end_date,a.`desc`, a.create_man_id, a.create_man,a.create_date,a.modify_date from project a left join project_product_demand b on a.id=b.project_id and b.is_deleted=false where b.product_demand_id = #{productDemandId} and a.is_deleted=false

select id,name, priority, type ,status,pm_id,pm pmName ,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, actual_start_date,actual_end_date,`desc`, create_man_id, create_man,create_date,modify_date from project where name = #{name} and is_deleted=false

select * from person p join project pj on p.main_id = pj.id join project_product_line ppl on pj.id = ppl.project_id where p.user_id = #{userId} and pj.status != 40 and pj.status != -20 and ppl.product_line_id = #{productLineId}
